# Femp

> Femp (also called Femp AI, by Femp AI, Inc.) is an assistant you text on WhatsApp or use in the Femp app, extended with plugins. Femp for DTC brands (in beta) runs operations for Shopify and Amazon stores: the pixel, ad spend against real sales, search and AI-assistant rankings, stock, chargebacks, the store's Gmail inbox and social posts. Femp for Jobs and Femp for Finance are coming soon. Femp acts only after the person says yes. Free during the beta.

Femp never changes prices, stock or checkout. Ads access is read-only. Product SEO and blog edits happen only after the owner says yes, and can be undone.

## Product
- [Home](https://femp.ai/): Femp as your first employee, and its plugins
- [Femp for DTC brands](https://femp.ai/dtc/): what Femp does for Shopify and Amazon stores, a WhatsApp demo and 20 ready-made automations
- [Femp for Jobs](https://femp.ai/jobs/): matching roles every morning, tailored applications, follow-ups (coming soon)
- [Femp for Finance](https://femp.ai/finance/): stock watchlist research, bills and subscriptions (coming soon)
- [Features](https://femp.ai/dtc/features/): Stock and days of cover, Meta and Google ads against real Shopify sales, SEO for Google and ChatGPT, and inbox triage, all over WhatsApp.
- [How it works](https://femp.ai/dtc/how-it-works/): Say hi on WhatsApp, connect Shopify or Amazon through their own sign-in, and get your first stock check minutes later. Nothing changes without your OK.
- [Integrations](https://femp.ai/dtc/integrations/): Femp AI connects to Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Meta Ads, Google Ads, Search Console and Gmail through each platform's own sign-in.
- [Pricing](https://femp.ai/dtc/pricing/): Femp AI is free during the beta: every feature, every connection and every automation for Shopify and Amazon stores.
- [Security](https://femp.ai/dtc/security/): Femp AI never touches prices, stock or checkout, edits SEO only after your OK, encrypts access tokens with AES-256 and never keeps passwords.
- [FAQ](https://femp.ai/dtc/faq/): What Femp AI is, who it's for, what it connects to, what it costs and whether it can change your store. Straight answers for Shopify and Amazon brands.
- [Privacy policy](https://auth.femp.ai/privacy)
- [Support](https://auth.femp.ai/support)

## Blog
- [47 ops jobs you can hand to an AI assistant, and the ones you shouldn't](https://femp.ai/blog/ai-operations-assistant-for-dtc-brands/): Most ops work at a DTC brand is watching, reconciling and chasing. 47 jobs an AI operations assistant can take over, and what should stay human.
- [Your store makes a story every day. Here's how to post it everywhere.](https://femp.ai/blog/dtc-social-media-stories-from-your-store/): Most store owners run their own social and burn out. Turn restocks, reviews and launches into daily stories, size them for every channel, and track which ones sell.
- [Your Meta pixel is missing sales. Here's how to tell, and how to fix it.](https://femp.ai/blog/meta-pixel-missing-purchases-shopify/): When the pixel misses purchases, Meta optimizes on bad data and your ads look worse than they are. How to spot the gap and fix tracking on Shopify.
- [Your ads say they're profitable. Your store disagrees.](https://femp.ai/blog/ads-roas-against-real-sales/): Meta and Google both claim the same sale. A simple daily check of ad spend against real Shopify orders that finds the ad sets losing money.
- [7 out of 10 carts never check out. Here's how to win some back.](https://femp.ai/blog/shopify-abandoned-carts-recover-sales/): About 70% of online carts are abandoned. Why buyers leave at checkout, the Shopify fixes that work, and a recovery email sequence that doesn't nag.
- [Most chargebacks are lost to a buried email. Here's how to win them.](https://femp.ai/blog/shopify-chargebacks-answer-every-dispute/): An unanswered chargeback costs the order, the product and a fee. The evidence that wins each dispute type, and how to never miss a deadline.
- [Why ChatGPT doesn't recommend your products, and how to fix it](https://femp.ai/blog/products-found-google-chatgpt/): Shoppers now ask ChatGPT and Google's AI what to buy. What gets a product into those answers, with a checklist for titles, descriptions and data.
- [Your best seller is about to sell out. This number warns you first.](https://femp.ai/blog/days-of-cover-inventory/): "40 left" means nothing without your sales pace. How to calculate days of cover, set a reorder point, and stop advertising sold-out products.
- [You're owed money in your invoices. Here's where it's hiding.](https://femp.ai/blog/money-hiding-in-your-invoices/): Payout shortfalls, carrier refunds, 3PL overcharges and invalid retailer deductions quietly take a few percent of revenue. Where to check weekly.
- [The DTC compliance calendar: every deadline that can cost you money](https://femp.ai/blog/dtc-compliance-calendar/): Sales tax nexus, 1099s, state reports, SMS consent, Prop 65 and accessibility: the deadlines a US DTC brand misses until the penalty letter arrives.
